name: mdview
description: Markdown viewer and editor for Windows, with a chat view for chat records written in a documented Markdown format

scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/build.mjs && electron . --selftest test/selftest/spec.json && electron . --selftest test/selftest/outline.json && node scripts/make-edit-spec.mjs && electron . --selftest test/selftest/edit.json && node scripts/make-lightbox-spec.mjs && electron . --selftest test/selftest/lightbox.json && node scripts/make-real-spec.mjs && electron . --selftest test/output/real.json && node scripts/cli-e2e.mjs
scripts.selftest:edit: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/make-edit-spec.mjs && electron . --selftest test/selftest/edit.json
scripts.selftest:lightbox: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/make-lightbox-spec.mjs && electron . --selftest test/selftest/lightbox.json
